text:
Aisha: Quick heads up — Snowflake Edge + Vector DB pilot kickoff scheduled for next Wed. Need to align marketplace listing window, hardware SKUs for private customers, and the joint announcement cadence.
Sanjay: 👍 timeline? we should pick an internal release (dedicated) date first before committing marketplace date.
Tina: I can own the Dedicated/GTM checklist. Can we confirm which quantized model variants we support for the pilot (8-bit vs q4)? that'll affect the hardware SKU ask.
Marco: For hardware partners, we need to confirm NVLink availability for on-prem boxes. I'll ping infra partner rep today.
Ben (Eng): On the SDK side, we need a tiny manifest to surface in Snowflake marketplace — sample manifest I sketched below. Can someone validate schema?
Ben (Eng): ```yaml
connector: 
  id: redwood-snowflake-edge-vector
  display_name: Redwood Edge Connector for Snowflake
  version: 0.1.0
  compatible_with: [snowflake-2025-rt, redwood-runtime-2.x]
  models: [rw-medium-q4_0, rw-small-q8_0]
```
Sanjay: That looks fine. Add a `supported_deployment_modes` field: [hosted, dedicated, private] and a `privacy_notes` blurb.
Aisha: Good call. Also we need a short security FAQ for the marketplace tile — Tina, can you draft with CISO review?
Tina: Yep, I'll draft and loop in security. Expect a PR by end of day tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Deployment workspace created: partners/snowflake-edge-vector/pilot-1769456789 — access granted to Aisha, Sanjay, Tina, Ben.
Marco: FYI I scheduled a sync with the Snowflake PM for Thu 10am PT. Agenda: marketplace metadata, partner co-marketing assets, timing for joint blog + press.
Aisha: Perfect. Action items: Tina -> security FAQ + PR, Ben -> add supported_deployment_modes + privacy_notes to manifest, Marco -> confirm NVLink and partner sync notes, Sanjay -> propose internal release date by EOD. We'll reconvene after Thu sync and lock marketplace publish date. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
